name: agent-model-map
body: The repo's agent→model configuration as a domain concept: the `opencode.json` `agent.<name>.model` entries that pin an opencode agent to a model, and the interview by which those entries are chosen. `opencode.json` is a MAIN-checkout file, so populating it is part of the agent-builder's main-write carve-out — the same carve-out as `.opencode/agents/**` (a second write path under it, not a third carve-out). The map is maintained NON-DESTRUCTIVELY (unrelated config keys and unmentioned existing entries survive a write) and deliberately omits `codebase-navigator`, which carries no model mapping. Distinct from `domain.entity.generated-agent-set` (which agents are generated) and `domain.entity.agent-scaffold-flow` (the on-main lifecycle): this entity is the model mapping attached to agents, spanning the generated set AND the distributed suite agents.
